aboutH2: Hope Valley Healing: Residential Addiction and Mental Health Care in Lindsay, Ontario
intro: Hope Valley Healing is a dedicated residential treatment centre located in Lindsay in the beautiful Kawartha Lakes region of Ontario. Surrounded by peaceful forests and wide open spaces, the setting creates a sense of calm that helps clients slow down, breathe, and focus on their recovery journey. The centre was created with the idea that healing becomes possible when people feel safe, supported, and truly understood, and that philosophy is reflected in everything they do.

What sets Hope Valley Healing apart is the personalized care they offer. Every client who comes through their doors receives an individual treatment plan that reflects their unique story and challenges. Instead of being placed into a rigid program, clients work closely with qualified and compassionate clinicians who take the time to understand their needs. This approach helps people dealing with addiction, mental health concerns, trauma, or emotional difficulties find a path forward that feels realistic and achievable.

pillars.title: A Lodge-Style House on Highway 35 Outside Lindsay
pillars.body: Hope Valley is a large wood-sided house on rural land along Highway 35 in the City of Kawartha Lakes, a short drive from Lindsay. The grounds have a pond in front of the house, a covered wooden bridge on the trail into the woods, a barn and a fire pit circled by red Muskoka chairs. Inside, people sleep in private or shared bedrooms and eat meals made by the centre's own chefs. Between sessions there are indoor and outdoor lounges, and walking trails run through the woods.

pillars.title: Lifetime Aftercare and Help With the Move Home
pillars.body: The centre has a Clinical Discharge and Transition Specialist and an Aftercare Coordinator on staff, so the move home has people assigned to it. Everyone who completes the program joins the alumni group, which Hope Valley offers as lifetime aftercare. Alumni stay in touch through virtual check-ins and group sessions, and there are community events and get-togethers too. Families are part of it from the start, with free Family First sessions every Monday evening.

pillars.title: Clinicians, Nurses and Peer Support Under One Roof
pillars.body: Clinical Director Brittany McDonald, RSSW, CCAC, leads the clinical team, and Meghann Hayward, RPN, is Head of Nursing. Around them are registered psychotherapists, addiction and mental health specialists, a trauma lead and several Canadian Certified Peer Support Specialists. Clients get prompt access to the centre's addictions doctor, and a psychiatrist can do a full assessment when the case calls for it. The gambling and sports betting program is run by Brittany Hillier, who the centre lists as a certified gambling specialist.

overview: The team at Hope Valley Healing blends evidence based clinical therapy with holistic methods that support the whole person. Clients may take part in counselling, group therapy, mindfulness practices, yoga, or other gentle wellness activities that help rebuild balance in daily life. The centre also offers specialized support for individuals such as first responders who may be coping with stress, PTSD, or long term workplace trauma.

afterOverview: The environment at Hope Valley Healing feels more like a warm lodge retreat than a traditional clinical setting. Clients can relax, reflect, and focus on themselves without the noise and pressure of everyday life. This peaceful atmosphere plays a big role in helping people reconnect with their goals and rediscover a sense of hope.

After completing their stay, clients are not left on their own. Hope Valley Healing provides ongoing aftercare and alumni support to help maintain progress and strengthen long term recovery. For anyone searching for compassionate addiction and mental health treatment in Lindsay and the Kawartha Lakes area, Hope Valley Healing offers a welcoming place to start again.

location.heading: Hope Valley Healing, Addiction & Wellness in Lindsay, Ontario
location.intro: Hope Valley Healing is at 3507 Highway 35, on rural land just outside Lindsay in the City of Kawartha Lakes. Toronto is about an hour and a half away by car, Peterborough is roughly 45 minutes, and Oshawa and the rest of Durham Region are about an hour south.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its own website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does Hope Valley Healing cost?
faqs.a: Hope Valley does not publish its prices, so you need to call admissions at (249) 288-5659 for a quote. The centre describes its fees as a modest pricing model and says financing options are available. Recovery.com lists it as private pay.

faqs.q: Is Hope Valley Healing covered by OHIP?
faqs.a: No. Hope Valley is a private centre, and its own FAQ says OHIP does not cover its programs. To help with cost it offers financing, and family members can attend its Family First sessions on Monday evenings for free.

faqs.q: What type of programs does Hope Valley Healing offer?
faqs.a: Hope Valley Healing provides residential treatment programs that combine clinical therapy with holistic wellness practices. Each client receives a customized plan that may include individual counselling, group therapy, mindfulness work, and supportive healing activities designed to strengthen long term recovery.

faqs.q: How long is the typical stay at Hope Valley Healing?
faqs.a: Their programs are flexible, and the length of stay depends on each person’s needs. Many clients choose a structured multi week stay to fully focus on healing, while others may extend their time if they need deeper therapeutic work or additional stabilization.

faqs.q: Does Hope Valley Healing offer detox?
faqs.a: Hope Valley does not run its own detox unit (recovery.com lists detox as not offered), but its website says it coordinates detox and medication-assisted treatment with its addictions doctor for people coming off opioids, fentanyl or prescription drugs. Clients get prompt access to that doctor and, case by case, to a psychiatrist for a full assessment. Tell admissions what you are using so they can plan a safe start.

faqs.q: What types of addictions and mental health issues do they treat?
faqs.a: Hope Valley Healing supports people dealing with substance use disorders, behavioral addictions, anxiety, depression, PTSD, emotional stress, trauma, and other mental health concerns. Their team creates individualized plans to address both the root causes and the daily challenges clients face.

faqs.q: Where is Hope Valley Healing and how do I get there?
faqs.a: The centre is at 3507 Highway 35 just outside Lindsay, in the City of Kawartha Lakes. It is about an hour and a half from Toronto, around 45 minutes from Peterborough and about an hour from Oshawa. Recovery.com notes that admissions staff help coordinate travel.

faqs.q: Is the environment suited for first responders or individuals with trauma backgrounds?
faqs.a: Yes. The centre offers specialized therapeutic support for first responders and individuals who have experienced trauma. Their clinical team is trained to work with complex cases, helping clients rebuild emotional safety, resilience, and coping skills.

faqs.q: Do clients receive support after leaving the facility?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Hope Valley Healing provides ongoing aftercare and an active alumni community. This support helps clients maintain progress, practice new habits, and stay connected with others who understand their journey.

faqs.q: Can families get support while someone is in treatment?
faqs.a: Yes. Hope Valley runs free Family First sessions every Monday evening for relatives of people in care. Recovery.com also lists family sessions and couples counselling among the centre's therapies.

faqs.q: Can Hope Valley help with an intervention for a loved one?
faqs.a: Yes. The centre offers professional intervention services, along with family coaching and crisis consultation. Interventions can be done virtually anywhere in Canada or in person depending on location, and the team also helps families find and get into the right treatment.
